# Compliance and Change-Control Policy Enforcement Checklist: Agentic Software Engineering System: URL Shortener

**Purpose**: Validate that policy evaluation, exceptions and change control are specified as versioned, blocking and auditable.
**Created**: 2026-10-15
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md) · [ADRs](../../../docs/adr/README.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.
**Item tags**: `[Mandatory]` means the criterion derives from the constitution, an approved requirement, or an accepted ADR or ruling. `[Optional]` means it concerns an enhancement. `[Dnn]` refers to a detection from the checklist brief; the detection map is in [../gates/release-evidence-gates.md](../gates/release-evidence-gates.md). Post-implementation evidence checks are in that gates file, not here. Every item is unchecked, including `[Optional]` items, so `/speckit-implement` reports this file as incomplete until a reviewer marks it.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Do the policy domains cover security, compliance, privacy, audit retention, approved dependencies, licensing and change control? [Completeness, Spec §FR-GOV-005; CON VI; policy-set.v1.yaml] [D07] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK002 Is recording of the evaluated policy-set version required for every run and every evaluation? [Completeness, Spec §FR-GOV-006] [D08] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK003 Is each check classified as mandatory or advisory, with the stage at which it is evaluated? [Completeness, policy-set.v1.yaml] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK004 Are the required exception fields enumerated, including compensating control and expiry or review condition? [Completeness, Spec §FR-GOV-008] [D11] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK005 Is formal impact analysis required for changes to requirements, architecture, schemas, workflow definitions, security controls and release criteria, at both run and repository level? [Completeness, Spec §FR-GOV-009; Plan §9.4] [D13] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the content of a Change Record specified (ownership, version impact, compatibility, consumers, tests, docs, rollout, approval)? [Completeness, contracts/README.md] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK007 Are policy evaluation outputs (outcome, evidence, reason, subject artifacts) specified by schema? [Completeness, contracts/schemas/policy-evaluation.schema.json] [Mandatory]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK008 Is it required that each applicable check yields exactly one of the four outcomes, with NOT-APPLICABLE conditions stated per check? [Clarity, Spec §FR-GOV-006; policy-set.v1.yaml] [D07] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK009 Is it specified that a mandatory FAIL blocks downstream progression, and which run state results? [Clarity, Spec §FR-GOV-007; Plan §9.1] [D09] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK010 Is it specified that EXCEPTION-REQUESTED blocks until a human approves or rejects, and that agents cannot approve exceptions? [Clarity, Spec §FR-GOV-007; Governance §2] [D10] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK011 Is the maximum exception lifetime quantified? [Measurability, policy-set.v1.yaml max_expiry_days] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the approval required for each change type identified (G-DESIGN within runs; a human-owner Change Record in the repository)? [Clarity, Plan §9.4; CR-001, CR-002] [D14] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the PRIV-001 detection method (lexicon) specified together with its known limitations? [Clarity, policy-set.v1.yaml PRIV-001; ADR-009] [Optional]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK014 Is the ST-03 routing rule (a requirement-level FAIL opens clarification; a FAIL that persists after clarification causes safe-stop) consistent with FR-GOV-007's blocking rule? [Consistency, Plan §9.1; Spec §FR-GOV-007] [D09] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK015 Are the non-waivable checks aligned with Governance §3? [Consistency, policy-set.v1.yaml non_waivable; Governance §3] [Mandatory]

## Scenario and Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK016 Is the effect of an exception expiring before release specified (release readiness FAIL)? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases; policy-set.v1.yaml REL-003] [D12] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK017 Is it specified how upstream changes mark downstream artifacts stale and trigger revalidation, at run and repository level? [Coverage, Spec §FR-ORC-020; Plan §9.4] [D13] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK018 Is the recorded exception path specified for a SEC-003 FAIL caused by scanner unavailability during scenario runs? [Clarity, Human Gate 4 ruling 5] [Mandatory]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- `[Gap]` = the requirement is missing; `[Ambiguity]` = the term or rule needs a definition; `[Conflict]` = two sources disagree; `[Assumption]` = relies on an unvalidated assumption
